card.title: SWYNE VOWS: "I WILL CLEAN UP OUR SEAFRONT"
card.body: Councillor Swyne condemned "the filth on our seafront" last night and promised a full clean-up of the Pier's "so-called amusements". Asked about his own visits to the Pier, the Councillor said he had been "inspecting".
